_help._file: How the first-game tutorial (content/lessons/first-game.json) is paced. Live in the Dev Kit's Tuning tab.
_help.dismissArmSeconds: A step's button only works after this long (s), so a quick tap can't close the words by accident.
_help.betweenStepsSeconds: A breath between one step and the next (s). 0 for a turn-based game: the rules switch the moment a step ends.
_help.slowSpeed: The game's speed while a step says 'slow' (0-1). The first-game lesson doesn't use it.
_help.gatePollMs: How often a step waiting on a number checks it (ms).
_help.nudgeGlowSeconds: A step waiting for a move: after this long with no move (s), what it points at glows.
_help.nudgeWordsSeconds: …and after this long (s), the words change to the nudge line (en.json lessons.shared.nudgeMove).
_help.nudgeRepeat: How many times the nudge words may show on one device visit.
